title: Construction of basic environment
summary: The Zepp OS development environment is very simple to set up, requiring only a Node.js environment and a code editor. This article will guide developers through a quick build of the Zepp OS development environment, including the installation of Node.js and the installation of the code editor.

snippets.code:
export NVM_DIR="$([ -z "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME-}" ] && printf %s "${HOME}/.nvm" || printf %s "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/nvm")"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" # This loads nvm
